messages:
Pri (CS): Heads-up 1: I put together a tiny "Warmfold Lite" runbook for accounts that need a fast, customer-facing checklist: lightweight prefill, client batching defaults, streaming fallback note, and renewal triggers. Posting for quick review.

Gus (SE): pasteable link?

Pri (CS): Internal draft: https://redwood.internal/cs/warmfold-lite (will publish after edits). Key goals: <90s checklist, a one-line curl, an inline batch snippet, and two short customer note variants.

Victor (PM): Good. Add a clear renewal-risk signal so CSMs know when to escalate.

Gus (SE): Copyable curl for CSMs (micro-prefill):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${CSM_KEY}" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rw-open-6b","prompt":"[warmfold_prefill] prime minimal","max_tokens":5}'
```
Operational knobs for Warmfold Lite: prefill TTL = 12m (720s), concurrency = 2, jitter 150-500ms. Keep payload token budget small to avoid quota surprises.

Gus (SE): Client batching guidance (web vs mobile): web = 70ms or 5 reqs; mobile = 140ms or 6 reqs. Prefer route tag `interactive` for chat flows and `bulk` for background jobs. Short JS collector snippet for CSM to paste: 
```js
// warmfold collector
let buf = []
function enqueue(req){ buf.push(req); if(buf.length>=5) flush(); else setTimeout(()=>flush(),70); }
function flush(){ /* send single batched request */ buf = [] }
```

Helena (SRE): Observability hooks to emit: `wf.prefill.attempt`, `wf.prefill.ok`, `wf.batch.flush_size`, `wf.stream.fallback`. Required tags: tenant_id, plan_tier, route. Alerts: if `wf.prefill.ok` < 80% for 15m while attempts > 0 -> notify CSM+SRE. If `wf.stream.fallback` > 3 in 30m -> auto-create internal case.

Pri (CS): Renewal-risk signals for the healthcard: (A) prefill failures >=3 within 72h, (B) stream fallback events >=2/day, (C) batch flush success ratio drop >=20% W/W. If any two conditions true -> flag yellow and schedule enablement check-in.

Victor (PM): Include a short outreach template and a 30-min calendar snippet that CSMs can paste. Keeps things consistent.

Pri (CS): Fallback note (concise customer variant):

"Hi there We're seeing intermittent streaming issues for your workspace. We've temporarily routed traffic to a stable, non-streaming mode to keep responses reliable. No action required; we'll update you within 1 hour. Reply if you'd like to run a quick test."

Pri (CS): Escalation variant (enterprise customers):

"Heads up We detected streaming instability affecting your workspace. We've switched your requests to a stable mode and our SRE team is investigating. Expect an update within 30 minutes. If you'd like logs or a test command, reply and we'll assist."

Helena (SRE): Sample sanitized logs CSMs can request from customers: 
```log
[2026-10-12T09:03:21Z] tenant=warmfold prefill=ok ttl=720 backend=g2
[2026-10-12T09:03:22Z] tenant=warmfold batch=flush size=4 latency_ms=82 route=interactive
[2026-10-12T09:05:10Z] tenant=warmfold stream=fallback reason=kv_miss count=1
```

Gus (SE): Troubleshooting steps for CSMs to paste: 1) confirm API key & scopes 2) run micro-prefill curl and paste raw response 3) include last 3 sanitized logs.

Pri (CS): I'll fold these edits into the one-pager and add the outreach calendar snippet. Helena, can you add the dashboard tile for `wf.*` metrics?

Helena (SRE): Yes I'll put a staging tile up today and push to prod tomorrow morning. I'll also add the auto-case action for the fallback alert.

assist-bot: Reminder: cs-brief at 14:00 UTC will review Warmfold Lite.

Pri (CS): Thanks everyone I'll publish after staging is live and send to the CSM cohort. Closing unless anyone has urgent changes.

Gus (SE): all set from SE.

Victor (PM): LGTM.
